content.text: Renewal terms sit at the preferred position across all elements; no redline needed.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 provides automatic renewal in successive twelve-month terms (no multi-year evergreen), a Customer-only non-renewal notice window of thirty days (well inside both the 30-day preferred and 60-day fallback limits), and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is not sent. Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of trailing twelve-month US CPI-U and three percent, with no increase on prepaid periods. Section 7.1 fixes Fees during the initial term and bars undisclosed surcharges, and no other renewal or escalator language appears in the document. The clause therefore meets the preferred position on every element; no redline is warranted.
